calculations.title: Ideal inductor AC reactance and current
calculations.formula: X_L = 2 pi f L; I_rms = V_rms / X_L; arg(Z_L) = +pi/2

calculations.title: Lossy-coil parallel phase resonance
calculations.formula: Y = 1/(r+j omega L)+j omega C; omega_r = sqrt((L-C r^2)/(L^2 C)); Z_r = L/(C r)

calculations.title: Ideal capacitor AC reactance and current
calculations.formula: X_C = 1/(2 pi f C); Im(Z_C) = -X_C; I_rms = V_rms/X_C

calculations.title: Series RLC impedance, phase and current
calculations.formula: Z = R + j(2 pi f L - 1/(2 pi f C)); |Z| = sqrt(R^2 + X^2); phi = atan(X/R)

calculations.title: Parallel RLC admittance and impedance
calculations.formula: Y = G+jB = 1/R + j(2 pi f C - 1/(2 pi f L)); Z = (G-jB)/(G^2+B^2)

calculations.title: Series resonator frequency, Q and exact bandwidth
calculations.formula: omega_0 = 1/sqrt(LC); Q = omega_0 L/R; delta_omega = R/L; omega_H = sqrt(omega_0^2+(R/(2L))^2)+R/(2L); omega_L = omega_0^2/omega_H

calculations.title: Single-phase sinusoidal power triangle
calculations.formula: S = V_rms I_rms; P = S cos(phi); Q = S sin(phi); PF = cos(phi)

calculations.title: Single-phase shunt capacitor power-factor correction
calculations.formula: Q_C = P(sqrt(1-PF_initial^2)/PF_initial - sqrt(1-PF_target^2)/PF_target); C = Q_C/(2 pi f V_rms^2)

calculations.title: Saturated BJT switch base-drive sizing
calculations.formula: Ib=Ic/beta_forced; Rb_max=(Vdrive_min-Vbe_sat_max)/Ib-Rdriver; Prb=Ib^2 Rb_max

calculations.title: Early-effect incremental output resistance
calculations.formula: Ic=I0(1+Vce/VA); ro=(VA+Vce)/Ic; go=Ic/(VA+Vce); ro_approx=VA/Ic

calculations.title: Matched BJT differential-pair current steering
calculations.formula: VT=kT/q; alpha=beta/(beta+1); x=Vdiff/VT; Ic1=alpha Itail exp(x)/(1+exp(x)); Ic2=alpha Itail/(1+exp(x)); d(Ic1-Ic2)/dVdiff=2 alpha Itail exp(x)/(VT(1+exp(x))^2); Idiff=alpha Itail expm1(x)/(1+exp(x))

calculations.title: Loaded-divider BJT DC operating point
calculations.formula: Vth=Vcc Rbottom/(Rtop+Rbottom); Rth=Rtop||Rbottom; Ib=(Vth-Vbe)/(Rth+(beta+1)Re); Ic=beta Ib; Vce=Vcc-Ic Rc-(beta+1)Ib Re

calculations.title: BJT hybrid-pi transconductance and input resistance
calculations.formula: VT=kT/q; gm=Ic/VT; rpi=beta_ac/gm

calculations.title: Loaded emitter-degenerated common-emitter gain
calculations.formula: RLc=Rc||RL; Rin=rpi+(beta+1)Re; Av_base=-beta RLc/Rin; Av_source=-beta RLc/(Rin+Rs)

calculations.title: BJT DC terminal power dissipation
calculations.formula: Pcollector=Vce Ic; Pbase=Vbe Ib; Ptotal=Pcollector+Pbase

calculations.title: Loaded emitter-follower gain and input resistance
calculations.formula: REeff=RE||RL; Rin=rpi+(beta+1)REeff; Av_base=(beta+1)REeff/Rin; Av_source=(beta+1)REeff/(Rin+Rs)

calculations.title: Ideal ADC LSB voltage
calculations.formula: M = 2^N; q = V_span / M

calculations.title: Ideal ADC code and quantization error
calculations.formula: q = (V_high - V_low)/2^N; k = floor((V_in - V_low)/q); V_hat = V_low + (k + 1/2)q; error = (k + 1/2)q - (V_in - V_low) = V_hat - V_in

calculations.title: Bandlimited ideal quantization SNR
calculations.formula: OSR = f_s/(2B); SNR_linear = a*2^N*sqrt((3/2)*OSR); SNR_dB = 20 log10(SNR_linear); process_gain_dB = 10 log10(OSR)

calculations.title: SAR ADC half-LSB acquisition settling
calculations.formula: tau = (R_source + R_switch) C_sample; alpha = abs(step)/V_span; t_min = tau ln(alpha * 2^(N+1))

calculations.title: Dynamic ENOB from measured SINAD
calculations.formula: ENOB = (SINAD_dB - 10 log10(3/2))/(20 log10(2))

calculations.title: Baseband Nyquist sampling margin
calculations.formula: f_N = f_s/2; margin = f_N - f_max; rate_ratio = f_s/(2f_max)

calculations.title: Sampled tone alias frequency
calculations.formula: k = floor(f_in/f_s + 1/2); f_alias = abs(f_in - k f_s)

calculations.title: Ideal unipolar DAC output voltage
calculations.formula: V_span = gain * V_ref; V_out = code * V_span/2^N; V_max_code = (2^N - 1)*V_span/2^N

calculations.title: Signed Ohm-law current
calculations.formula: I = V / R

calculations.title: Loaded Wheatstone bridge and common-mode voltage
calculations.formula: Va0 = Vs R2/(R1+R2); Vb0 = Vs R4/(R3+R4); Ra = R1||R2; Rb = R3||R4; Id = (Va0-Vb0)/(Ra+Rb+Rd); Va = Va0-Id Ra; Vb = Vb0+Id Rb; Vdiff = Id Rd; Vcm = (Va+Vb)/2

calculations.title: Two-source resistive node with load
calculations.formula: G = 1/R1+1/R2+1/Rl; Vnode = (V1/R1+V2/R2)/G; I1 = (V1-Vnode)/R1; I2 = (V2-Vnode)/R2; Il = Vnode/Rl

calculations.title: Steady resistor dissipation
calculations.formula: P = I^2 R

calculations.title: Two series branches in parallel
calculations.formula: A = R1 + R2; B = R3 + R4; Req = A B / (A + B); I1 = V / A; I2 = V / B

calculations.title: Finite-load voltage divider
calculations.formula: Vopen = Vin Rbottom/(Rtop+Rbottom); Rout = Rtop Rbottom/(Rtop+Rbottom); Vloaded = Vopen Rload/(Rout+Rload); error = Rout/(Rout+Rload)

calculations.title: Resistive source loading and maximum-power match
calculations.formula: I = Vth/(Rs+Rl); Vl = I Rl; Pl = I^2 Rl; Ps = I^2 Rs; Rmatch = Rs; Pmax = Vth^2/(4 Rs)

calculations.title: Delta-to-star resistor equivalence
calculations.formula: S = Rab+Rbc+Rca; Ra = Rab Rca/S; Rb = Rab Rbc/S; Rc = Rbc Rca/S

calculations.title: LED series resistor and tolerance corners
calculations.formula: R = (Vs - N Vf)/I; Imax = (Vs,max - N Vf,min)/R; PR,max = (Vs,max - N Vf,min)^2/R

calculations.title: Shockley diode current and incremental resistance
calculations.formula: VT = kT/q; ID = IS[exp(VD/(n VT))-1]; rd = n VT/(ID+IS)

calculations.title: Zener shunt-regulator resistor design window
calculations.formula: Rnom,min = (Vin,max - Vz,min)/[(Iz,max + IL,min)(1-t)]; Rnom,max = (Vin,min - Vz,max)/[(Iz,min + IL,max)(1+t)]

calculations.title: Diode reverse-recovery charge and commutation budget
calculations.formula: Qrr ≈ IR,peak ttriangle/2; EQ = VR Qrr; PQ = fcomm EQ; IQ,avg = fcomm Qrr

calculations.title: Bridge rectifier waveform-dependent conduction loss
calculations.formula: VF(i) = V0 + rd i; Pbridge = 2(V0 Iavg + rd Irms^2); Pdiode = Pbridge/4

calculations.title: Full-wave capacitor-input rectifier ripple
calculations.formula: fr = 2 fline; Vpk = sqrt(2) Vac,rms - 2 VF; Vr,pp = IL/(fr C); Vdc ≈ Vpk - Vr,pp/2; Vr,rms ≈ Vr,pp/sqrt(12)

calculations.title: Biased two-sided diode clipper
calculations.formula: VH = Vref,H + VF,H; VL = Vref,L - VF,L; Vo = min(max(Vi,VL),VH)

calculations.title: Two-branch LED ballast and current sharing
calculations.formula: Rmin = abs(VF2-VF1)/DeltaIallow; I1 = [Itotal+(VF2-VF1)/R]/2; I2 = [Itotal+(VF1-VF2)/R]/2

calculations.title: First-order RC low-pass response
calculations.formula: H(jw)=1/(1+jwRC); fc=1/(2*pi*R*C); x=f/fc; |H|=1/sqrt(1+x^2)

calculations.title: Butterworth order and cutoff from attenuation specifications
calculations.formula: N=ceil(ln((10^(As/10)-1)/(10^(Ap/10)-1))/(2*ln(fs/fp))); fc_min=fp/(10^(Ap/10)-1)^(1/(2*N)); fc_max=fs/(10^(As/10)-1)^(1/(2*N)); loss differences use equivalent log1p/expm1 forms

calculations.title: General Sallen-Key low-pass pole, Q and response
Fliege notch component and frequency response
First-order RC high-pass response
calculations.formula: H(jw)=jwRC/(1+jwRC); fc=1/(2*pi*R*C); |H|=x/sqrt(1+x^2); phase=atan(1/x); attenuation=(10/ln(10))*log1p(1/x^2)

calculations.title: Buffered identical RC low-pass cascade
calculations.formula: H(s)=(1/(1+sRC))^N; fc_total=fc_stage*sqrt(2^(1/N)-1); |H|=(1+x^2)^(-N/2); phase=-N*atan(x); attenuation=(10*N/ln(10))*log1p(x^2)

calculations.title: Ideal transformer turns ratio and reflected load
calculations.formula: a = Ns/Np; Vs = a Vp; Rprimary = Rload/a²

calculations.title: Rectangular-section toroid inductance
calculations.formula: L = mu0 mur N² h ln(ro/ri)/(2 pi); Binner = mu0 mur N Ipk/(2 pi ri)

calculations.title: Finite-permeability gapped-core inductance
calculations.formula: Rc = lc/(mu0 mur w h); Rg = g/(mu0 w h); L = N²/(Rc+Rg); Bpk = N Ipk/((Rc+Rg) w h)

calculations.title: Good-conductor skin depth
calculations.formula: delta = sqrt(1/(pi f mu0 mur sigma)); require sigma/(2 pi f eps0 epsr) >= 100

calculations.title: Mutual and series-connected coupled-coil inductance
calculations.formula: M = k sqrt(L1 L2); Laiding = L1+L2+2M; Lopposing = L1+L2-2M

calculations.title: Sinusoidal transformer peak flux density
calculations.formula: Bpk = sqrt(2) Vrms/(2 pi f N Ae); Phiflux,pk = Bpk Ae

calculations.title: Magnetic field energy in a material volume
calculations.formula: u = B²/(2 mu0 mur); W = u Volume

calculations.title: Two-secondary transformer VA budget
calculations.formula: S1 = V1,rms I1,rms; S2 = V2,rms I2,rms; Sload = S1+S2; Sminimum = headroom Sload

calculations.title: Gate-charge average supply current and drive power
calculations.formula: I_supply = Q_g f_sw; E_drive = Q_g V_drive; P_drive = E_drive f_sw

calculations.title: Gate-loop critical-damping resistor selection
calculations.formula: R_critical = 2 sqrt(L_loop/C_iss); R_external = max(0, R_critical - R_driver - R_internal); zeta = (R_driver + R_internal + R_external)/R_critical

calculations.title: Bootstrap capacitance from gate and driver charge budget
calculations.formula: Q_total = Q_g + I_hbs D_max/f_sw + I_hb/f_sw; V_headroom = V_dd - V_diode - V_min; C_min = Q_total/Delta_V

calculations.title: MOSFET output-capacitance hard turn-on loss
calculations.formula: E_oss = C_o_er V_ds^2/2; P_oss = E_oss f_sw

calculations.title: MOSFET conduction loss with on-state current ripple
calculations.formula: I_rms = sqrt(D (I_mean^2 + Delta_I_pp^2/12)); P_cond = I_rms^2 R_ds_on

calculations.title: Clamped-inductive switching overlap loss
calculations.formula: E_on = V_off I_load t_on/2; E_off = V_off I_load t_off/2; P_overlap = (E_on + E_off) f_sw

calculations.title: Miller plateau source/sink timing
calculations.formula: I_on = (V_drive - V_plateau)/(R_source + R_external + R_internal); I_off = V_plateau/(R_sink + R_external + R_internal); t_on = Q_gd/I_on; t_off = Q_gd/I_off

calculations.title: Long-channel NMOS triode-region current
calculations.formula: beta = mu_n C_ox W/L; V_overdrive = V_gs - V_th; I_d = beta (V_overdrive V_ds - V_ds^2/2)

calculations.title: Resistor Johnson noise
calculations.formula: e_n = sqrt(4 k T R); v_rms = e_n sqrt(B)

calculations.title: Non-inverting amplifier white-noise budget
calculations.formula: G_N=1+R_F/R_G; e_o^2=(e_n^2+(i_plus R_S)^2+4kTR_S)G_N^2+(i_minus R_F)^2+4kTR_F G_N; v_o=e_o sqrt(B); v_in=v_o/G_N

calculations.title: Three-stage Friis noise cascade
calculations.formula: c=ln(10)/10; G_i=10^(g_i/10); s=NF_1 exprel(c NF_1)+NF_2 exprel(c NF_2)/G_1+NF_3 exprel(c NF_3)/(G_1G_2); F_total=1+c s; NF_total=s log1prel(c s); T_e=NF_1 (290 c) exprel(c NF_1)+NF_2 (290 c) exprel(c NF_2)/G_1+NF_3 (290 c) exprel(c NF_3)/(G_1G_2)

calculations.title: Junction shot noise
calculations.formula: i_n = sqrt(2 q I); i_rms = sqrt(2 q I B)

calculations.title: Three-source RMS noise sum
calculations.formula: v_total = sqrt(v_1^2 + v_2^2 + v_3^2)

calculations.title: Analog dynamic range and detection margin
calculations.formula: V_max,rms=V_peak/sqrt(2); V_min,rms=V_noise,rms 10^(SNR_req/20); DR_noise=20log10(V_max,rms/V_noise,rms); DR_usable=20log10(V_max,rms/V_min,rms)

calculations.title: Noise figure to equivalent input temperature
calculations.formula: F=10^(NF/10); c=ln(10)/10; T_e=NF (290 c) exprel(c NF)

calculations.title: Inverting amplifier with reference bias
calculations.formula: G = -Rf/Rin; Vo = Vref + G(Vin - Vref)

calculations.title: Finite-gain dominant-pole amplifier bandwidth
calculations.formula: N = 1+Rf/Rg; fp = GBW/A0; Gdc = A0/(1+A0/N); fcl = fp(1+A0/N); fcl_approx = GBW/N; relative_error = 1/(1+A0/N)

calculations.title: Noninverting amplifier with reference bias
calculations.formula: G = 1 + Rf/Rg; Vo = Vin + (Rf/Rg)(Vin - Vref)

calculations.title: Three-input weighted summing amplifier
calculations.formula: Gi = -Rf/Ri; Vo = Vref - Rf[(V1-Vref)/R1+(V2-Vref)/R2+(V3-Vref)/R3]

calculations.title: Integrator constant-input ramp
calculations.formula: dVo/dt = -(Vin-Vref)/(R C); Vo(t) = Vo_initial - (Vin-Vref)t/(R C)

calculations.title: Differentiator response to an input ramp
calculations.formula: m = (Vend-Vstart)/T; Vo = Vref - Rf C m

calculations.title: Sinusoidal output slew-rate requirement
calculations.formula: SRrequired = 2 pi f Vpeak; SRdesign = M SRrequired; available_margin = SRavailable/SRrequired

calculations.title: PCB trace DC resistance and voltage drop
calculations.formula: A = w t; R = rho L / A; V_drop = I R

calculations.title: Legacy IPC-2221 trace current screening estimate
calculations.formula: A_mil2 = w_mil t_mil; I_external = 0.048 DeltaT^0.44 A_mil2^0.725; I_internal = 0.024 DeltaT^0.44 A_mil2^0.725

calculations.title: Plated via-barrel DC resistance
calculations.formula: A = pi p (d + p); R_single = rho L / A; R_bank = R_single / N

calculations.title: Annular ring with hole-registration allowance
calculations.formula: r_nominal = (D_pad - D_tool)/2; r_min = r_nominal - offset

calculations.title: Nominal PCB copper weight to thickness
calculations.formula: t_nominal = copper_weight * 35e-6 m; t_mil = t_nominal / 25.4e-6 m

calculations.title: Differential-pair routed length-mismatch skew
calculations.formula: DeltaL = L_positive - L_negative; Delta_t = DeltaL * delay_per_length; skew = abs(Delta_t)

calculations.title: Trace volumetric Joule heating and deposited energy
calculations.formula: J = I/(w t); q_volume = rho J^2; P = q_volume L w t; E = P duration

calculations.title: Rectangular solder-stencil aperture area ratio
calculations.formula: A_open = L W; A_wall = 2 (L+W) T; AR = A_open/A_wall; margin = AR - target

calculations.title: LDO dissipation including ground current
calculations.formula: Ppass = (Vin-Vout) Iout; Pgnd = Vin Ignd; Pdiss = Ppass+Pgnd

calculations.title: Boost output capacitor with ESR budget
calculations.formula: D = (Vout-Vin)/Vout; ILpeak = Iout Vout/Vin+delta_I/2; Vesr_pp = ESR ILpeak; Cmin = Iout D/[fs (Vbudget_pp-Vesr_pp)]

calculations.title: Buck input capacitor RMS current
calculations.formula: D = Vout/Vin; ICin_rms = hypot(Iout sqrt(D (Vin-Vout)/Vin), delta_I sqrt(D/12))

calculations.title: Boost right-half-plane zero
calculations.formula: D = (Vout-Vin)/Vout; Rload = Vout/Iout; fRHPZ = (Vin/Iout) (Vin/Vout)/(2 pi L); fc_guideline = fRHPZ/10

calculations.title: Converter input current and loss budget
calculations.formula: Pout = Vout Iout; Pin = Pout/eta; Iin = Pin/Vin; Ploss = Pout (1-eta)/eta = Pin-Pout

calculations.title: Buck CCM inductor sizing
calculations.formula: D = Vout/Vin; delta_I = r Iout; Lmin = (Vin-Vout) D/(fs delta_I); Ipeak,valley = Iout (1 +/- r/2)

calculations.title: Boost CCM inductor sizing
calculations.formula: D = (Vout-Vin)/Vout; ILavg = Iout Vout/Vin; delta_I = r ILavg; Lmin = Vin D/(fs delta_I); Ipeak,valley = ILavg (1 +/- r/2)

calculations.title: Buck output capacitor with ESR budget
calculations.formula: Vesr_pp = ESR delta_I; Vcap_budget = Vbudget_pp-Vesr_pp; Cmin = delta_I/(8 fs Vcap_budget)

calculations.title: Transmission-line delay and wavelength
calculations.formula: v=c/sqrt(ee); td=l/v; lambda=v/f; theta=2*pi*l/lambda; c=299792458 m/s

calculations.title: Quarter-wave impedance transformer
calculations.formula: Ztransformer=sqrt(Rsource*Rload); length=c/(4*f*sqrt(ee))

calculations.title: Homogeneous coaxial line impedance
calculations.formula: Z0=(60/sqrt(er))*ln(b/a)

calculations.title: Resistive-load reflection and first arrival
calculations.formula: Gamma=(RL-Z0)/(RL+Z0); Vr=Gamma*Vi; VL=2*RL/(RL+Z0)*Vi; reflected_fraction=Gamma^2; accepted_fraction=4*RL*Z0/(RL+Z0)^2

calculations.title: Source-series termination for an open receiver
calculations.formula: Rseries=Z0-Rdriver; Vlaunch=Vstep*Z0/(Rdriver+Rseries+Z0); Vreceiver=2*Vlaunch

calculations.title: Single-pole rise-time equivalent bandwidth
calculations.formula: BW=ln(9)/(2*pi*tr) approximately 0.35/tr

calculations.title: Linear resistor power derating
calculations.formula: f=min(1,max(0,(T_zero-Ta)/(T_zero-T_rated))); P_allowed=P_rated f; margin=P_allowed-P_actual

calculations.title: Junction temperature with electrothermal feedback
calculations.formula: P(Tj)=P_ref[1+beta(Tj-T_ref)]; g=R_th P_ref beta; Tj=Ta+R_th P_ref[1+beta(Ta-T_ref)]/(1-g); P_eq=P_ref[1+beta(Ta-T_ref)]/(1-g)

calculations.title: Arrhenius accelerated-life exposure
calculations.formula: AF=exp[(Ea/k_B)(1/T_use-1/T_test)]; t_equivalent=AF t_test; k_B=8.617333262145e-5 eV/K

calculations.title: Maximum heatsink thermal resistance
calculations.formula: R_total,max=(Tj_limit-Ta)/P; R_sa,max=R_total,max-R_jc-R_cs

calculations.title: Two parallel solid-conduction heat paths
calculations.formula: R_i=L_i/(k_i A_i); R_eq=1/(1/R_1+1/R_2); T_hot=T_sink+P R_eq; Q_i=(T_hot-T_sink)/R_i

calculations.title: Lumped body temperature after a power step
calculations.formula: C_th=rho V c_p; R_th=1/(h A_s); tau=R_th C_th; Bi=h V/(A_s k); T_inf=Ta+P R_th; T(t)=T_inf+(T_initial-T_inf) exp(-t/tau)

calculations.title: Resistor resistance drift from temperature
calculations.formula: dR/R_ref=TCR_ppm*1e-6*(T-T_ref); R(T)=R_ref[1+dR/R_ref]

calculations.title: Free linear thermal expansion
calculations.formula: strain=alpha(T_final-T_initial); dL=L_initial strain; L_final=L_initial+dL

calculations.title: 16-bit toggle timer clock divider
calculations.formula: count = floor(f_clock/(2 P f_target)+0.5); compare = count-1; f_actual = f_clock/(2 P count)

calculations.title: Finite-edge lumped capacitive crosstalk
calculations.formula: tau = R_v(C_m+C_v); x = t_edge/tau; V_divider = C_m DeltaV/(C_m+C_v); V_peak = V_divider [-expm1(-x)/x]

calculations.title: UART baud mismatch and stop-sample margin
calculations.formula: n = 1 + data_bits + parity_bits + 0.5; early = n/B_rx - (n-0.5)/B_tx - guard; late = (n+0.5)/B_tx - n/B_rx - 1/(S B_rx) - guard

calculations.title: Parallel-plate displacement current
calculations.formula: C = epsilon_0 epsilon_r width length/gap; slew = DeltaV/t_edge; I_displacement = C slew; J_displacement = I/(width length)

calculations.title: I2C pullup resistance bounds
calculations.formula: R_min = (V_supply - V_OL)/I_sink; R_max = t_r/[ln(7/3) C_bus]; width = R_max - R_min

calculations.title: RC Schmitt-input digital delay bounds
calculations.formula: t_early = -RC log1p(-V_Tmin/V_supply)+t_gate_min; t_late = -RC log1p(-V_Tmax/V_supply)+t_gate_max; log1p(z) = ln(1+z)

calculations.title: Synchronous register setup slack
calculations.formula: available = T + skew - t_setup - uncertainty; arrival = t_CQ + t_path; slack = available - arrival

calculations.title: Inductive turn-off voltage spike
calculations.formula: current_fall_rate = (I_initial-I_final)/t_fall; spike = L current_fall_rate; switch_voltage = V_supply + spike

calculations.title: RC charge or discharge after a voltage step
calculations.formula: tau=RC; vC=Vs+(V0-Vs)exp(-t/tau); iC=(Vs-vC)/R; t_settle=-tau ln(epsilon); EC=C vC^2/2; ER=C(Vs-V0)^2[1-exp(-2t/tau)]/2

calculations.title: Unbuffered two-stage RC ladder startup
calculations.formula: a=R1R2C1C2; b=R1C1+R1C2+R2C2; tau_s=(b+sqrt(b^2-4a))/2; tau_f=a/tau_s; v2=Vs[1-(tau_s exp(-t/tau_s)-tau_f exp(-t/tau_f))/(tau_s-tau_f)]; v1=v2+R2 C2 dv2/dt

calculations.title: Underdamped series-RLC step ringing and peak stress
calculations.formula: alpha=R/(2L); wn=1/sqrt(LC); zeta=alpha/wn; wd=sqrt(wn^2-alpha^2); vC=Vs{1-exp(-alpha t)[cos(wd t)+(alpha/wd)sin(wd t)]}; i=Vs exp(-alpha t)sin(wd t)/(L wd); tp=pi/wd; Mp=exp(-alpha pi/wd)

calculations.title: Periodic RC charging extrema under two-level excitation
calculations.formula: a=exp(-Th/RC); b=exp(-Tl/RC); Vmin=[Vl(1-b)+b Vh(1-a)]/(1-ab); Vmax=Vmin+(Vh-Vmin)(1-a); Vavg=(VhTh+VlTl)/(Th+Tl)

calculations.title: RL current buildup or decay after a voltage step
calculations.formula: tau=L/R; If=Vs/R; iL=If+(I0-If)exp(-t/tau); vL=(Vs-RI0)exp(-t/tau); t_settle=-tau ln(epsilon)

calculations.title: Constant-current capacitor ramp and energy
calculations.formula: dv/dt=I/C; vC=V0+It/C; deltaQ=It; EC=C vC^2/2; deltaE=C(vC^2-V0^2)/2

calculations.title: Two-capacitor charge redistribution through resistance
calculations.formula: Ceq=C1C2/(C1+C2); tau=R Ceq; Vf=(C1V1+C2V2)/(C1+C2); deltaV(t)=(V1-V2)exp(-t/tau); Eloss=Ceq(V1-V2)^2/2

calculations.title: RC tracking of a finite-slope voltage ramp
calculations.formula: Vs(t)=Vs0+mt; tau=RC; vC=Vs0+m(t-tau)+(V0-Vs0+m tau)exp(-t/tau); iC=Cm+(Vs0-V0-m tau)exp(-t/tau)/R
